verdict.rationale: Hightouch's core model is warehouse-native: models are defined via SQL/dbt/BI queries directly on warehouse tables (docs-2, docs-23), audiences/Customer Studio build on top of these warehouse models (docs-19, docs-43), and syncs activate data to destinations on a schedule without re-collecting or storing it elsewhere (docs-20, docs-27, docs-26 CDC computed in-warehouse). Independent community testimony corroborates that syncs are declarative SQL-to-destination mappings and that Hightouch stores no data itself, keeping everything in the customer's own warehouse (hightouch-comm-2, hightouch-comm-3). Missing for 10: independent hands-on performance benchmarks proving no-recollection at scale, and no third-party audit of the 'no data stored' claim beyond company/community anecdote.
